newsitem.title: USA: Prudential names new financial, investment officers.
newsitem.headline: Prudential names new financial, investment officers.

text.p: Prudential Insurance Co of America said on Thursday its board of directors named Richard Carbone chief financial officer and William Bethke chief investment officer.
Newark, N.J.-based Prudential, the country's largest life insurer, said those positions were previously held by Mark Grier, executive vice president for financial management.
Prudential said Carbone and Bethke will report to Grier.
Carbone comes to Prudential from Salomon Inc, where he was controller and a managing director of Salomon Brothers since 1995, Prudential said.
He previously held the position of managing director and controller at Bankers Trust New York Corp from 1988 to 1992.
Bethke, who joined Prudential in 1974, is currently president of Prudential's Capital Markets Group.
